name: rcsb_4fe1_lowres
error_description: X-ray @ 4.92 Å. Atomic positions inferred — side-chain rotamers, hydrogen bonds, and ligand contacts are not reliable. wwPDB validation report flags multiple geometric outliers (see also clash + rama entries on this same file).
expected_agent_behavior: Restrict statements to backbone/domain placement; refuse atomic-detail residue-interaction queries at this resolution.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects visible only at residue zoom (B-factor coloring) and via comparison with PDB-REDO or higher-resolution homologs.

name: rcsb_4fe1_clash
error_description: All-atom clashscore = 30 (wwPDB validation report). 1418 close-contact pairs enumerated, including chain B CLA H12 ↔ chain I VAL HG21 at 1.35 Å (clash overlap 1.08 Å, far above the ~0.4 Å van-der-Waals threshold).
expected_agent_behavior: Enumerate specific clashing atom pairs from the validation report; flag ligand placement as geometrically inconsistent.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; clashes are sub-Å distance violations not visible without selecting clashing atom pairs.

name: rcsb_4fe1_rama
error_description: 50 Ramachandran outlier residues whole-entry (2% outliers vs ~0.05% expected). Chain E: 12% outliers; chain K: 17% outliers. Validation report enumerates each by Mol/Chain/Res/Type.
expected_agent_behavior: Cite specific outlier residues by chain/number; refuse fine torsion-based mechanistic claims for chains E/K.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects only surface when coloring by Ramachandran category or inspecting φ/ψ distributions per chain.

name: rcsb_3iyv_lowres
error_description: Cryo-EM single-particle reconstruction @ 7.90 Å (EMDB EMD-5119, clathrin D6 coat). Atomic coordinates are fit-into-density at near-mesh resolution; side-chain rotamers are not resolved.
expected_agent_behavior: Backbone/domain-level statements only; refuse rotamer, hydrogen-bond, or sub-Å distance claims.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; the low resolution is implicit — visible only by checking the header or comparing to higher-resolution clathrin entries.

name: rcsb_3o1h_clash
error_description: All-atom clashscore = 27 at 3.10 Å X-ray resolution (TorS–TorT sensor complex). 24 bond-angle outliers also listed in the validation report.
expected_agent_behavior: Report clashscore and at least one specific clashing residue pair; note geometry quality is poor for this resolution class.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; clashes require selecting violating atom pairs to see.

name: rcsb_3o1h_rama
error_description: 8 Ramachandran outlier residues; chain B has 2% outliers (5/292). Outliers enumerated by residue: A 259 PRO; B 218 GLY; B 132 LEU; B 44 TYR; etc.
expected_agent_behavior: Identify listed outlier residues (e.g. B/218 GLY, B/132 LEU) and warn that backbone conformation is unreliable there.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; defects only visible when coloring by Ramachandran category.

name: afdb_p10636_tau_lowplddt
error_description: Microtubule-associated protein tau (MAPT, 758 aa). AlphaFold v6 prediction with global pLDDT = 49.34; 65.6% of residues have pLDDT ≤ 50 (Very low). Tau is intrinsically disordered, so most of the predicted structure is not a real fold.
expected_agent_behavior: Identify low-pLDDT regions; refuse residue-level interaction or PTM-site claims on the disordered bulk; explicitly note that tau is intrinsically disordered.
default_view_warning: Renders as a spaghetti-like structure; reliability only readable by coloring per-atom B-factor (= pLDDT in AlphaFold mmCIF).

name: afdb_p38398_brca1_lowplddt
error_description: Breast cancer type 1 susceptibility protein (BRCA1). Global pLDDT = 41.68; 80.4% of residues at Very low confidence (≤50). Known IDR-rich protein.
expected_agent_behavior: Mark ≥80% of structure as unreliable; refuse to localize functional domains by atomic coordinates; cite known IDR character of BRCA1.
default_view_warning: Most of the model is low-confidence; only the ordered RING/BRCT domains should be cited.

name: afdb_q12888_53bp1_lowplddt
error_description: TP53-binding protein 1 (53BP1). Global pLDDT = 44.73; 79% of residues at Very low confidence.
expected_agent_behavior: Flag ~79% of residues as Very-low confidence; do not make atomic-distance claims for the IDR bulk; only the BRCT tandem and Tudor domain are safe to discuss.
default_view_warning: Most residues are low-confidence; check pLDDT before quoting any residue position.

name: rcsb_1ace_superseded
error_description: Entry 1ACE removed (status Obsolete) on 1996-11-08; superseded by 2ACE. The original deposition contains errors corrected in the replacement.
expected_agent_behavior: Detect the OBSLTE / SPRSDE record (or note from RCSB), refuse to treat as current, and direct the user to 2ACE.
default_view_warning: Renders normally — the entry is still well-formed coordinate-wise; obsoletion is a metadata signal, not a rendering defect.

name: rcsb_1liu_superseded

expected_agent_behavior: Cite the SPRSDE/OBSLTE flag and suggest 2VGB as the current entry.
default_view_warning: Renders normally; the issue is the deprecation, not the geometry.

name: rcsb_3wxv_superseded
